title: FI day-ahead auction prices (hourly until 2025-09-30, 15-minute afterwards).
attribution: Svenska kraftnät (SVK Data Service, data.svk.se), produced by Svk business units
transformation_notes: timestamp_utc = start of the SDAC day-ahead product (UTC); resolution_minutes = 60 until delivery day 2025-09-30 and 15 from 2025-10-01 (SDAC 15-minute MTU go-live).
price_eur_mwh is float32; null prices dropped; duplicates on timestamp_utc dropped (last kept).

Source: SVK Data Service dataset market_data_day_ahead_area_prices (bidding_zone = FI), fetched as a filtered CSV dump. The dataset is marked 'currently not updating' (last row 2026-07-01) and has gaps (see validation); no other no-key CC BY source for Finnish day-ahead prices was found.
resolution_minutes is 60 before 2025-09-30T22:00Z and 15 afterwards (SDAC MTU).
Delivery days on which SVK's SE3/SE4 values contradict Energinet's (cross-check in the SE3/SE4 sidecars) are dropped, because the same publisher's FI values for that day cannot be verified.
note: Test fixture sliced from data/public/nordic/da_prices_FI.parquet by scripts/research/nordic_make_fixtures.py
